silhouette.reason: Lumpy rock with craters, pits and glowing crystal clusters, distinct per seed. But the base is clipped flat at z = 0 and the fracture half-spaces cut near-vertical walls, so FRONT and SIDE in sheet.png read as a rounded box on a floor, not a free body in space.
fixes: drop the flat z = 0 clip (bounds from below the body) or keep it only for a ground-resting variant
raise the fracture-plane reach (rng.range(0.62, 0.8) → 0.75–0.9) and use fewer chips so they facet the lumps instead of squaring the sides

proportions.reason: Declared envelope per variant; crater sizes in proportion to the body; crystals at a believable scale against the 0.5 m grid.
fixes: vary the aspect between variants more (one elongated ~2:1 body) as real small bodies are rarely this blocky

materials.reason: Regolith on the asphalt strip tinted carbonaceous, ochre ore veins, cyan glowing crystals. The asphalt pattern reads as a fine tiled tread in hero.png, the hero is close to black with little value range, and the vein edges stair-step at the vertex cell in every sheet view.
fixes: a project regolith material with larger clasts and iron-nickel flecks instead of the asphalt strip
blend the vein colour across vertices with a falloff (or sample it per pixel) so veins stop stair-stepping
lift the regolith albedo one step so craters read in the hero

detail.reason: Craters with rims, pits, veins and crystal clusters; between them the surface is smooth blobby SDF at 0.17 m with no rubble or boulders.
fixes: boulders and rubble resting in crater floors
a finer secondary noise octave at LOD0 for rock grain

wear.reason: Darkened crater floors and veins; otherwise uniform. No fresh ejecta, no mining scars around the crystal sites.
fixes: bright fresh ejecta rays around the youngest crater
drill scars and tailings around the crystal mining sites

lod.reason: LOD2 (616) keeps the outline, the crystals and the colour blocks, but the veins become large triangle patches.
fixes: drop the vein colour at LOD2 (keep the base tint) so it does not turn into triangle patches

technical.reason: QA PASS; 20 392 / 4 324 / 616 triangles, two draws, glow on the crystals.
fixes: shrink the sdf bounds to the body extent (ext = max size + 3.2 m wastes cells) to cut build time
